Sandbox_Skylights_IndoorBrightness_toolt: How bright a room gets under an intact skylight, as a percentage of the outdoor light. 100 = as bright as outside, 0 = completely dark. The light spreading to nearby tiles scales with it.
Sandbox_Skylights_BreakChance_tooltip: Percent chance that the glass breaks each time a player or zombie steps onto a skylight. 100 = breaks on the first step, 0 = never breaks.
